title: La Sobremesa: sus movimientos
description: Each of La Sobremesa's moves with its own motion of the rigged body (src/sobremesa.ts moveOn) and its effect (src/dual-fx.ts § La Sobremesa), Anna's Sopeta healing the table in green. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click();

window.seen = new Set(); window.nextFriend = () => { if (window.ready()) cmd('defend'); const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('.battle-speech-line[data-speaker]:not([data-leaving])')].find(l => !window.seen.has(l.dataset.speaker)); if (!l) return false; window.seen.add(l.dataset.speaker); return true; }
